title: TransLLMate
description: Translate messages using a local LLM
body:
# TransLLMate
Simple ***local translation*** mod. Does not need anything but serving a local\* LLM for translation
- \* - through local/remote OpenAI-compatible API
## Usage
1. Open chat in a multiplayer server
2. Shift-Click other's message, then wait for the magic
## Configuration
Accesible through Mod Menu and `/transllmate` command
The options should be self-explanatory enough
## Tested models
- `gemma3-4b` - OK-ish accuracy
- `gemma3-12b` - Good accuracy at expense of compute and RAM
- `qwen3-4b` - Overall bad accuracy, may understand Chinese better than any other language
- `Maybe some other model[s]?`
